what: THE FLAGSHIP RESULT: muODE's dynamic dFBA reproduces Clark 2021 community composition end-to-end. Full mechanism (hybrid gapseq/BiGG panel + ATPM yield calibration + physiological mu_max=0.6 cap + pFBA determinism) run dynamically on all 549 measured communities (richness 2-25), scored as composition MAE.
interpretation: Dynamic MAE 0.114 BEATS the null (0.164), the old raw dFBA (0.210, where we started -- worse than null), AND the static OD-weighting proxy (0.118), landing within 0.006 of the theoretical OD ceiling (0.108). The dynamics don't just preserve the yield signal -- with the mu_max cap they slightly improve on it.

the_full_arc.tier1_monoculture: ATPM yield calibration -> mono biomass tracks measured OD (spearman 0.60->0.81 hybrid vs BiGG-only)

mechanism_chain: reconstruction fix (gapseq Bacteroidetes, namespace-harmonized) -> ATPM yield calibration to measured OD -> physiological mu_max rate cap (post-solve flux-scaling) -> pFBA for cross-platform determinism. ONE global mu_max parameter (vs gLV's ~n^2 fitted interactions).
reproducibility: pFBA makes fluxes deterministic across platforms (aarch64==x86_64 to 4 decimals); run on ts-02 (224-core x86_64), ~hours.
remaining_caveats: 6 strains (BL,BH,DF,BA,CH,DP) under-grow in BOTH reconstructions -- next frontier.
mu_max=0.6 is one global value (data is endpoint-only; per-strain would need genome-derived rates e.g. gRodon -- discussed, deferred).
